text:
## PART 4: LAW ENFORCEMENT COORDINATION  
### When to Report to Police  
**Mandatory Police Report:**
- Confirmed fraud >£10,000
- Serial fraud (multiple victims, pattern)
- Organized fraud ring
- Impersonation/identity theft
- Check fraud (coordinated with bank systems team)
- Customer requests police report  
**Optional Police Report:**
- Fraud >£5,000 (encouraging reports)
- Repeated fraudster (pattern recognition)
- Suspected insider fraud (always report)

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement Coordination Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for determining when and how to report fraud incidents to law enforcement. Establishes mandatory and optional reporting thresholds based on fraud type, amount, pattern, and customer request.

raw_entities.name: Confirmed Fraud Assessment
raw_entities.description: Evaluation step to determine if fraud has been confirmed and assess whether the amount exceeds £10,000 threshold for mandatory police reporting.

raw_entities.name: Serial Fraud Pattern Detection
raw_entities.description: Analysis step to identify whether fraud involves multiple victims or demonstrates a recognizable pattern indicative of organized or serial fraud activity.

raw_entities.name: Organized Fraud Ring Assessment
raw_entities.description: Investigation step to determine whether the fraud is part of an organized fraud ring operation, triggering mandatory police escalation.

raw_entities.name: Identity Theft and Impersonation Check
raw_entities.description: Verification step to identify cases involving impersonation or identity theft, which mandate police reporting regardless of amount.

raw_entities.name: Check Fraud Coordination
raw_entities.description: Coordination step with bank systems team to verify check fraud incidents and determine police reporting requirement.
context: Check fraud (coordinated with bank systems team)

raw_entities.name: Customer Police Report Request Handling
raw_entities.description: Process step to handle customer requests for police reports, which trigger mandatory reporting regardless of fraud amount or type.

raw_entities.name: High-Value Fraud Reporting Decision
raw_entities.description: Optional reporting decision for fraud exceeding £5,000 threshold, with encouragement to report to police for pattern recognition and prevention.

raw_entities.name: Repeated Fraudster Pattern Recognition
raw_entities.description: Analysis step to identify repeat fraudsters and recognize patterns that may warrant optional police reporting for prevention purposes.

raw_entities.name: Suspected Insider Fraud Escalation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory escalation step for suspected insider fraud cases, which always require police reporting regardless of amount or other factors.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Police Report Trigger
raw_entities.description: Decision gate determining whether fraud incident meets mandatory reporting criteria (confirmed fraud >£10,000, serial fraud, organized ring, identity theft, check fraud, customer request, or insider fraud).
context: Check fraud (coordinated with bank systems team)

raw_entities.name: Optional Police Report Assessment
raw_entities.description: Decision gate for optional police reporting of fraud between £5,000-£10,000, repeated fraudster patterns, or other discretionary cases where reporting is encouraged but not mandated.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation Team
raw_entities.description: Team responsible for assessing fraud incidents, determining reporting thresholds, and coordinating with law enforcement and bank systems teams.

raw_entities.name: Bank Systems Team
raw_entities.description: Team responsible for coordinating check fraud verification and providing technical assessment to support police reporting decisions.
context: Check fraud (coordinated with bank systems team)

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement Authority
raw_entities.description: External law enforcement agency receiving mandatory and optional fraud reports from the bank.

raw_entities.name: Confirmed Fraud Event
raw_entities.description: Fraud incident that has been confirmed and assessed for police reporting based on amount, type, pattern, and customer request.

raw_entities.name: Identity Theft Fraud Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud alert triggered by impersonation or identity theft, mandating immediate police reporting.

raw_entities.name: Check Fraud Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud alert for check-related fraud incidents requiring coordination with bank systems team and police reporting assessment.
context: Check fraud (coordinated with bank systems team)

raw_entities.name: Insider Fraud Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud alert for suspected insider fraud, which always mandates police reporting regardless of amount or other factors.

properties.purpose: Determine when and how to report fraud incidents to law enforcement authorities
properties.scope: All confirmed and suspected fraud cases across all products and channels
properties.trigger: Fraud detection, customer request, or pattern recognition
properties.outcome_success: Appropriate law enforcement notification made within regulatory timeframe; evidence preserved
properties.outcome_failure: Failure to report mandatory cases; regulatory breach; loss of evidence

properties.input: Fraud alert, transaction records, customer statement
properties.output: Confirmed fraud determination; threshold classification (>£10,000 or ≤£10,000)
properties.failure_path: Escalate to supervisor for secondary review

properties.input: Transaction history, customer profile, fraud database
properties.output: Pattern determination; identification of multiple victims or repeated incidents

properties.input: Cross-customer fraud patterns, network analysis, transaction linkages
properties.output: Organized fraud ring determination; suspect network mapping

properties.input: Customer identity documents, account access logs, verification records
properties.output: Identity theft or impersonation confirmation; victim notification requirement

properties.input: Check fraud alert, clearing house records, bank systems data
properties.output: Coordinated check fraud determination; coordination confirmation from Bank Systems Team

properties.input: Customer request for police report, fraud case file
properties.output: Police report generated and provided to customer; law enforcement notification triggered

properties.input: Fraud amount, case classification, decision point outcome
properties.output: Law enforcement report submission or optional reporting recommendation

properties.input: Historical fraud records, repeat offender database, transaction patterns
properties.output: Repeat fraudster identification; optional police report recommendation

properties.input: Insider fraud indicators, employee access logs, transaction anomalies
properties.output: Insider fraud determination; mandatory law enforcement notification
properties.failure_path: Immediate escalation to senior management and compliance

properties.decision_question: Does the fraud case meet mandatory reporting criteria?
criteria: Serial fraud with multiple victims or clear pattern
Customer explicit request for police report
properties.path_yes: Proceed to law enforcement notification; generate police report
properties.path_no: Proceed to optional police report assessment (dp_002)

properties.decision_question: Should an optional police report be filed?
properties.path_yes: Recommend and facilitate police report filing
properties.path_no: Close fraud case; document decision rationale

properties.authority_level: Fraud case assessment and determination; optional reporting recommendation
Receipt and investigation of fraud reports

properties.generation_trigger: Fraud investigation confirms fraudulent transaction or account activity
properties.investigation_or_escalation_path: Threshold assessment (>£10,000 triggers mandatory police report)
properties.customer_notification: Notification of fraud confirmation and police report status

properties.generation_trigger: Detection of impersonation or unauthorized use of customer identity
properties.investigation_or_escalation_path: Mandatory law enforcement notification; victim support coordination

properties.generation_trigger: Fraudulent check detected; coordinated with bank systems
properties.investigation_or_escalation_path: Bank Systems Team coordination; mandatory police report if confirmed
properties.customer_notification: Notification of check fraud and police report status

properties.generation_trigger: Suspected fraudulent activity by bank employee or authorized user
properties.investigation_or_escalation_path: Immediate escalation to senior management and compliance; always report to police
